title: Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor BP-220 Service and Calibration Manual

passages.text: As preventive maintenance, clean the cuff and hose and check the battery every 6 months.
The Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor (BP-220) must be calibrated every 12 months against a certified pressure reference.
If a reading differs from the pressure reference by more than 3 mmHg during calibration, stop using the unit and contact Technical Service.
